meta.title: Watchtower
meta.description: Avoid it when you're an enemy, run to it when you're a friend.

units.rawText: Meanwhile, on the outskirts of the Rossum Sector, in the open expanse of the Null Area.
units.displayText: Meanwhile, on the outskirts of the Rossum Sector, in the open expanse of the Null Area.

spans.text: Meanwhile, on the outskirts of the Rossum Sector, in the open expanse of the Null Area.

units.rawText: Antonina types furiously on her keyboard, writing programs nonstop to delay the pursuers behind us.
units.displayText: Antonina types furiously on her keyboard, writing programs nonstop to delay the pursuers behind us.

spans.text: Antonina types furiously on her keyboard, writing programs nonstop to delay the pursuers behind us.

units.rawText: Are there still a lot of Entropics behind us?
units.displayText: Are there still a lot of Entropics behind us?

spans.text: Are there still a lot of Entropics behind us?

units.rawText: They don't seem to have thinned out. I estimate half the Entropics in this sector are following you.
units.displayText: They don't seem to have thinned out. I estimate half the Entropics in this sector are following you.

spans.text: They don't seem to have thinned out. I estimate half the Entropics in this sector are following you.

units.rawText: Did you arrange for me to follow you knowing this would happen?
units.displayText: Did you arrange for me to follow you knowing this would happen?

spans.text: Did you arrange for me to follow you knowing this would happen?

options.rawText: Thank you so much, you've been a great help.
options.displayText: Thank you so much, you've been a great help.

spans.text: Thank you so much, you've been a great help.

options.rawText: Hey, it's your fault for being so skilled. "The able should work harder" and all that.
options.displayText: Hey, it's your fault for being so skilled. "The able should work harder" and all that.

spans.text: Hey, it's your fault for being so skilled. "The able should work harder" and all that.

units.rawText: Humph, as long as you know.
units.displayText: Humph, as long as you know.

spans.text: Humph, as long as you know.

units.rawText: You really are a terrible boss.
units.displayText: You really are a terrible boss.

spans.text: You really are a terrible boss.

units.rawText: Still, can you really hold up at the rate you're burning through operands?
units.displayText: Still, can you really hold up at the rate you're burning through operands?

spans.text: Still, can you really hold up at the rate you're burning through operands?

units.rawText: I've already improved my computational efficiency.
units.displayText: I've already improved my computational efficiency.

spans.text: I've already improved my computational efficiency.

units.rawText: ...Did you have a suggestion in mind when you brought that up?
units.displayText: ...Did you have a suggestion in mind when you brought that up?

spans.text: ...Did you have a suggestion in mind when you brought that up?

units.rawText: According to your analysis, Odile is probably the leader of this attack, or one of the leaders.
units.displayText: According to your analysis, Odile is probably the leader of this attack, or one of the leaders.

spans.text: According to your analysis, Odile is probably the leader of this attack, or one of the leaders.

units.rawText: We'll need to fight her sooner or later, so we need to preserve our strength.
units.displayText: We'll need to fight her sooner or later, so we need to preserve our strength.

spans.text: We'll need to fight her sooner or later, so we need to preserve our strength.

units.rawText: Well, we can store up all the strength we want, but we only have a few people with us.
units.displayText: Well, we can store up all the strength we want, but we only have a few people with us.

spans.text: Well, we can store up all the strength we want, but we only have a few people with us.

units.rawText: What if we had reinforcements?
units.displayText: What if we had reinforcements?

spans.text: What if we had reinforcements?

units.rawText: I point in the direction where we're headed.
units.displayText: I point in the direction where we're headed.

spans.text: I point in the direction where we're headed.

units.rawText: The Entropics are currently gathered at 11 o'clock, which is where the Rossum Sector is.
units.displayText: The Entropics are currently gathered at 11 o'clock, which is where the Rossum Sector is.

spans.text: The Entropics are currently gathered at 11 o'clock, which is where the Rossum Sector is.

units.rawText: We'll head in the 2 o'clock direction. It'll be safer there for the time being.
units.displayText: We'll head in the 2 o'clock direction. It'll be safer there for the time being.

spans.text: We'll head in the 2 o'clock direction. It'll be safer there for the time being.

units.rawText: What are you trying to do?
units.displayText: What are you trying to do?

spans.text: What are you trying to do?

units.rawText: You'll know once we get there.
units.displayText: You'll know once we get there.

spans.text: You'll know once we get there.

units.rawText: It isn't just the Rossum Sector that's been attacked. Cyclopes, Helios and Enigma have all been hit by the Entropics.
units.displayText: It isn't just the Rossum Sector that's been attacked. Cyclopes, Helios and Enigma have all been hit by the Entropics.

spans.text: It isn't just the Rossum Sector that's been attacked. Cyclopes, Helios and Enigma have all been hit by the Entropics.

units.rawText: Why is it that there are no traces of the Entropics in the 2 o'clock direction alone?
units.displayText: Why is it that there are no traces of the Entropics in the 2 o'clock direction alone?

spans.text: Why is it that there are no traces of the Entropics in the 2 o'clock direction alone?

units.rawText: It means somebody must be there clearing them out.
units.displayText: It means somebody must be there clearing them out.

spans.text: It means somebody must be there clearing them out.

units.rawText: Who else is there who can fight the Entropics besides ourselves... The Sanctifiers or "Arcadia"?
units.displayText: Who else is there who can fight the Entropics besides ourselves... The Sanctifiers or "Arcadia"?

spans.text: Who else is there who can fight the Entropics besides ourselves... The Sanctifiers or "Arcadia"?

units.rawText: That's why I sent part of the vanguard team over. They'll be back soon.
units.displayText: That's why I sent part of the vanguard team over. They'll be back soon.

spans.text: That's why I sent part of the vanguard team over. They'll be back soon.

units.rawText: Antonina bites her lip before reluctantly looking away from me and focusing on her keyboard.
units.displayText: Antonina bites her lip before reluctantly looking away from me and focusing on her keyboard.

spans.text: Antonina bites her lip before reluctantly looking away from me and focusing on her keyboard.

units.rawText: Professor! There's a Sanctifier Watchtower up ahead!
units.displayText: Professor! There's a Sanctifier Watchtower up ahead!

spans.text: Professor! There's a Sanctifier Watchtower up ahead!

units.rawText: ...I've spotted it on the map too. There's a Sanctifier Watchtower there; it was added shortly after Rossum activated its Sandbox Mode.
units.displayText: ...I've spotted it on the map too. There's a Sanctifier Watchtower there; it was added shortly after Rossum activated its Sandbox Mode.

spans.text: ...I've spotted it on the map too. There's a Sanctifier Watchtower there; it was added shortly after Rossum activated its Sandbox Mode.

options.rawText: I already said you could trust me, right?
options.displayText: I already said you could trust me, right?

spans.text: I already said you could trust me, right?

options.rawText: Actually, I figured it out by chance just now.
options.displayText: Actually, I figured it out by chance just now.

spans.text: Actually, I figured it out by chance just now.

units.rawText: You're always doing this...
units.displayText: You're always doing this...

spans.text: You're always doing this...

units.rawText: That attitude of yours just makes me more mad.
units.displayText: That attitude of yours just makes me more mad.

spans.text: That attitude of yours just makes me more mad.

units.rawText: In any case, we should be able to send signals at this distance. I'll give it a try.
units.displayText: In any case, we should be able to send signals at this distance. I'll give it a try.

spans.text: In any case, we should be able to send signals at this distance. I'll give it a try.

units.rawText: Better hurry, there are more and more Entropics chasing us.
units.displayText: Better hurry, there are more and more Entropics chasing us.

spans.text: Better hurry, there are more and more Entropics chasing us.

units.rawText: We soon receive a reply after I send my message.
units.displayText: We soon receive a reply after I send my message.

spans.text: We soon receive a reply after I send my message.

units.rawText: [Unknown communications request detected. Please respond.]
units.displayText: [Unknown communications request detected. Please respond.]

spans.text: [Unknown communications request detected. Please respond.]

units.rawText: So quickly? I thought we'd have to wait several minutes to get through...
units.displayText: So quickly? I thought we'd have to wait several minutes to get through...

spans.text: So quickly? I thought we'd have to wait several minutes to get through...

units.rawText: [Provide identity authentication and state your circumstances.]
units.displayText: [Provide identity authentication and state your circumstances.]

spans.text: [Provide identity authentication and state your circumstances.]

units.rawText: We're agents. We're under viral attack, and we need Sanctifier backup!
units.displayText: We're agents. We're under viral attack, and we need Sanctifier backup!

spans.text: We're agents. We're under viral attack, and we need Sanctifier backup!

units.rawText: [...Switching circuits...]
units.displayText: [...Switching circuits...]

spans.text: [...Switching circuits...]

units.rawText: [This is Sanctifier Watchtower 05. Communications request received. State the objective of your transmission.]
units.displayText: [This is Sanctifier Watchtower 05. Communications request received. State the objective of your transmission.]

spans.text: [This is Sanctifier Watchtower 05. Communications request received. State the objective of your transmission.]

units.rawText: Didn't we just tell you? How are Lesser Sanctifiers this dumb!
units.displayText: Didn't we just tell you? How are Lesser Sanctifiers this dumb!

spans.text: Didn't we just tell you? How are Lesser Sanctifiers this dumb!

units.rawText: I repeat, we are under attack and the situation is critical. As for our identity, Eosphorus will vouch for us.
units.displayText: I repeat, we are under attack and the situation is critical. As for our identity, Eosphorus will vouch for us.

spans.text: I repeat, we are under attack and the situation is critical. As for our identity, Eosphorus will vouch for us.

units.rawText: We need help and we need it now!
units.displayText: We need help and we need it now!

spans.text: We need help and we need it now!

units.rawText: [Sanctifiers are not permitted to leave the Watchtower without orders from superiors.]
units.displayText: [Sanctifiers are not permitted to leave the Watchtower without orders from superiors.]

spans.text: [Sanctifiers are not permitted to leave the Watchtower without orders from superiors.]

units.rawText: So are you just going to sit back and watch as ordinary agents get infected by viruses?
units.displayText: So are you just going to sit back and watch as ordinary agents get infected by viruses?

spans.text: So are you just going to sit back and watch as ordinary agents get infected by viruses?

units.rawText: [Sanctifiers are not permitted to leave the Watchtower without orders from superiors.]
units.displayText: [Sanctifiers are not permitted to leave the Watchtower without orders from superiors.]

spans.text: [Sanctifiers are not permitted to leave the Watchtower without orders from superiors.]

units.rawText: [Search and destroy operations were carried out around the Watchtower today. No viruses detected.]
units.displayText: [Search and destroy operations were carried out around the Watchtower today. No viruses detected.]

spans.text: [Search and destroy operations were carried out around the Watchtower today. No viruses detected.]

units.rawText: Is it telling us to go over...
units.displayText: Is it telling us to go over...

spans.text: Is it telling us to go over...

units.rawText: Antonina, how far are we from the Watchtower?
units.displayText: Antonina, how far are we from the Watchtower?

spans.text: Antonina, how far are we from the Watchtower?

units.rawText: At our current speed, we should be there in 10 minutes or so.
units.displayText: At our current speed, we should be there in 10 minutes or so.

spans.text: At our current speed, we should be there in 10 minutes or so.

units.rawText: Hey, uh, Sanctifier, we'll be bringing a ton of viruses your way in about 10 minutes. Be prepared for a fight.
units.displayText: Hey, uh, Sanctifier, we'll be bringing a ton of viruses your way in about 10 minutes. Be prepared for a fight.

spans.text: Hey, uh, Sanctifier, we'll be bringing a ton of viruses your way in about 10 minutes. Be prepared for a fight.

units.rawText: I hang up without waiting for it to reply.
units.displayText: I hang up without waiting for it to reply.

spans.text: I hang up without waiting for it to reply.

units.rawText: Let's go before they react to it.
units.displayText: Let's go before they react to it.

spans.text: Let's go before they react to it.

units.rawText: You're pretty good at getting others to do your dirty work, Professor.
units.displayText: You're pretty good at getting others to do your dirty work, Professor.

spans.text: You're pretty good at getting others to do your dirty work, Professor.

units.rawText: Cleansing viruses is the Sanctifiers' job. Plus, I'm guessing from the look on your face that you don't mind all that much either.
units.displayText: Cleansing viruses is the Sanctifiers' job. Plus, I'm guessing from the look on your face that you don't mind all that much either.

spans.text: Cleansing viruses is the Sanctifiers' job. Plus, I'm guessing from the look on your face that you don't mind all that much either.

units.rawText: Well, we're counting on the Sanctifiers to do it for us. Will we be safe after this?
units.displayText: Well, we're counting on the Sanctifiers to do it for us. Will we be safe after this?

spans.text: Well, we're counting on the Sanctifiers to do it for us. Will we be safe after this?

units.rawText: We should focus on making it to the Watchtower alive first.
units.displayText: We should focus on making it to the Watchtower alive first.

spans.text: We should focus on making it to the Watchtower alive first.
